A listing with one declaration that is not a version at all.

== Description ==

"latest" reads like an answer and is not one. It names no release, so nothing can
be started against it, nothing can be compared with the required minimum, and the
claim the directory prints on the plugin page means whatever its reader assumes.

A gate that skipped what it could not parse would call this listing clean, which
is the failure this fixture exists to catch: an unreadable declaration has to be
reported with the line it is on, exactly like a wrong one.
